_note: Story layer on top of the walk spec: who stands where, scripted crossings, props. Coordinates in 2400x1339 plate pixels. Bark lines are placeholders, not book text. Pen: two drow guards patrol the rope bridge outside the gate and Jorlan Duskryn stands on the landing by the door (Sam, 2026-10-11). objects (Sam's editor, 2026-10-24): what is in each room and whether it can be used (interact) or is only set dressing (decor); names from OotA p.17-20, no positions yet. INHABITANTS (Sam's playtest, 2026-10-24): who the book puts in each room, with the book's own odds — `rolls` names dice rolled once per plate per session; an npc's `when` {roll, in} says which results put them here, `chance` a flat probability, `dice`+`spots` how many at which posts, `at` a named roll picking one spot. `watch` {passive} is the sentries' passive Perception the leader's Stealth is rolled against on the way in (OotA p.15). Positions are Claude's placement by eye on the painted plates, not Sam's — nudge freely. `_src` cites the page.

gate.name: The pen gate
gate.locked: Heavy iron bars bolted into the stone. Locked.
gate.open: The gate stands open. Beyond it, the balcony: a rope bridge to the guard tower, and stairs down the cliff.

routes.10: Out across the rope bridge to the Guard Tower
routes.12: Down the cliff stairs to the Quaggoth Den

balcony._note: Sam, 2026-10-23: 'The drow should be able to open the gate and come in and vice versa.' Outside the bars: the rope bridge and the rock landing by Jorlan's post, traced on the plate. In a fight it is floor. Once the gate is open, the way between the landing and the threshold goes round behind the pillar (Jorlan's own route in openGate), out of sight, and costs passFt of movement. Drawn at the guards' size (scale, = their fixedScale), not by the pen's depth. keys: who carries the gate key (house assumption: the outpost's guards and Jorlan).

chasm._note: Sam, 2026-10-28 (Pen Strip Pilot): 'create a zone where people can be thrown off and fall to their deaths'. A shove from the balcony that lands off its floor goes over the edge. Into `webs` (the silk under the near and far ends of the rope bridge): caught, restrained, unhurt (Sam's falls ruling, 2026-10-24: the webs below the outpost break a fall). Anywhere else (`drops`, or beyond them): the chasm, a fall of hundreds of feet, 20d6 (the SRD 5.1 cap) - dead. That depth is Claude's reading of the painting, not a number from the book. Polygons in pen plate px, traced in the close-up painting and carried back through the outside mesh.

outside._note: Sam, 2026-10-28/29 (Pen Strip Pilot, 'lets wire what we have'): step out of the gate and the camera slides onto this close-up of the landing and the rope bridge; step in and it slides back. One world, two views: every point on the balcony keeps the pen plate's coordinates and is carried into the painting by the triangle mesh pen[i] -> art[i] (art in this painting's own px, 2400x1339; built by hand against both paintings, no triangle flipped). x0: where the painting sits beside the plate. ft: the painting's px per foot [far, near, at y far, at y near] (the pilot's sizes, the ones Sam okayed after 'minimize people looking like they are flying'). door: the painted gate's quad; doorFloor: the floor in front of it. domainX: the balcony side of the pen wall, in plate px.

gray-ooze.note: to the outside of the gate, where Malachar had it (2026-10-12: it reaches the gate, touches the bars). `inside` is the chasm-side entry Malachar narrated (2026-10-13 21:28: it oozes up the stone wall from the pool below the pen) — it heaves up over the ledge at the pen's left rim, by the crystals. The approved film shows an under-the-bars entry instead; `insideGate` keeps that path for when he brings it through the gate.

inside.via: heaving itself up over the ledge from the chasm

11.wards: The wards cut into the pen's walls smother any spell cast inside it; a spell cast from outside still reaches in.

spots._note: Where a cast member goes when Malachar tags [NPC_MOVE: name | where] with this word in it. Plate pixels, matched by substring, first match wins. gate/bars = outside the pen gate where the ooze touched the bars; landing/door = Jorlan's post; bridge = the rope bridge; tower = its far end.

props.name: Ilvara's chest
props._src: OotA ch.1 area 7 (Ilvara's Quarters): 'A heavy chest of black-stained zurkhwood sits at the foot of the bed.' Locked; the key is in a hidden pocket inside Ilvara's belt. Poison-needle trap on the lock, set off by any attempt to open it without the key: 1 piercing, DC 13 CON or poisoned 1 hour (fail by 5+: also unconscious). DC 20 INT (Investigation) finds it; thieves' tools + DC 15 DEX disarms it; thieves' tools + DC 15 DEX picks the lock. Traced by eye on the painted plate, 2026-10-14.
